question: Which of these is a micronutrient?
solution:
The correct answer is__** iron.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Micronutrients are essential nutrients required in small quantities by the human body for optimal health and functioning.**
 
• Iron is a micronutrient that plays a crucial role in the production of** red blood cells and the transport of oxygen throughout the body.**
 
• Carbohydrates are macronutrients that provide energy to the body, but they are not considered micronutrients.
 
• Fibre is a type of carbohydrate that **cannot be digested by the body and helps to regulate digestion and prevent constipation, but it is also not considered a micronutrient.**
 
• Water is also not considered a micronutrient, but it is** essential for hydration and many bodily functions.**
 
• Carbohydrates are one of the three macronutrients, along with** proteins and fats.**
 
• Fibre is found in plant-based foods such as fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and legumes.
 
• Water makes up approximately 60% of the human body and is necessary for many bodily processes, including regulating body temperature, transporting nutrients, and removing waste.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The essentials of an element for a plant are divided into two broad categories on the basis of their quantitative requirements.
 
• Macronutrients
